title: ThinkNet: Evolutionary Deep Ensembles for Efficient Motor-Imagery EEG Classification
abstract: arXiv:2609.33967v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Practical assistive and rehabilitative brain--computer interfaces require subject-independent motor-imagery EEG (MI-EEG) decoders that generalize to new users under limited target-user data and constrained compute. However, held-out-subject performance can be overstated when test-subject information influences preprocessing, model selection, or ensemble selection. We present \textit{ThinkNet}, a validation-controlled framework that combines train-only normalization, validation-guided evolutionary search, and validation-gated inference to identify compact decoders and inference policies for held-out subjects. We evaluate four-class BCI Competition IV-2a (session T) decoding with nine Leave-One-Subject-Out (LOSO) folds, three seeds, seven fixed decoder entries, and a broader search over ten representative decoder families; the held-out subject is never used for normalization, hyperparameter, architecture, or ensemble-policy selec

translated_title: ThinkNet：用于高效运动想象脑电分类的进化式深度集成框架
translated_abstract: 实用的辅助与康复类脑机接口需要受试者无关的运动想象脑电（MI-EEG）解码器，能够在目标用户数据有限且计算资源受限的条件下泛化到新用户。然而，当测试受试者的信息影响了预处理、模型选择或集成选择时，留出受试者的性能可能被高估。我们提出了ThinkNet，这是一个验证控制的框架，结合仅基于训练数据的归一化、验证引导的进化搜索和验证门控推理，为留出受试者识别紧凑的解码器与推理策略。我们在BCI Competition IV-2a（T会话）四分类解码任务上进行评估，采用九个留一受试者交叉验证折、三个随机种子、七个固定解码器条目，并对十个代表性解码器家族进行更广泛的搜索；留出受试者从不被用于归一化、超参数、架构或集成策略的选择。
tldr: ThinkNet提出了一种验证控制的框架，通过仅训练数据归一化、验证引导的进化搜索和验证门控推理，在严格防止测试受试者信息泄露的前提下，实现面向新用户的高效、紧凑的运动想象脑电分类。
en_tdlr: ThinkNet is a validation-controlled framework that combines train-only normalization, validation-guided evolutionary search, and validation-gated inference to achieve efficient and compact subject-independent motor-imagery EEG classification while strictly preventing test-subject information leakage.
